tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Wizard101 creatures, spells, quests and zones by name or by facts (school, world, boss, rank, pips). Typos are forgiven. Returns names with their page address, for get_page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One page's full record: a creature (stats, resists, typed boss cheats, spells), a spell (pips, accuracy, effects, every card of that name), a quest (giver, goals, rewards, what it leads to and needs, where it fits in its tree) or a zone. Each fact has a tier: client is from the game files, community

tools.name: quest_categories
tools.description: The quest categories with counts and starting quests: each world's main story, the school quest lines, side quests by world, instances, events, and quests not sorted yet.

tools.name: quest_tree
tools.description: Walk one quest category as a tree from its start: main quests in order with the side quests that branch off them, by-school stages, what each quest needs, and where the next quest is not known yet.

tools.name: list_gaps
tools.description: What the wiki does not know yet (bosses without cheats, creatures without a known deck, drops, quests without steps). If your user's own game data fills one, ask them first; contributions go through the wiki's API (see its /openapi.json) and are reviewed.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
